note: Automated bookkeeping for small businesses, Austin. Shut down in June 2020 (FinTech Global, 2020-06-24), as the Coatue row reads. The band read the Form D of 2018-12-21 as a Series A; Crunchbase News (2019-08-08) places a $10M Series A in mid-2018 and a $30M Series B seven months before the Series C, with Bessemer a returning investor at the C, and Bessemer's directors first appear on the 2019 filings. So the December 2018 filing is the first close of the Series B that Bessemer led (the lead named from knowledge), a Growth entry.

E-procurement software for laboratories and universities, Research Triangle area of North Carolina. IPO in 1999, taken private in 2004, listed again in 2010, then acq. by Accel-KKR, 2016, for $509M and renamed Jaggaer (Wikipedia).

Mobile games publisher, Culver City. Acq. by Savvy Games Group, 2023, for $4.9B, as the sibling rows read. NoSQL database, Herzliya and Palo Alto (FinSMEs); Global Venturing calls it Israel-based. Global Venturing (2017-03-10): 'Bessemer had previously led ScyllaDB's $7m series A round in 2013, back when the company was still a cloud operating system developer known as Cloudius Systems', matching the firm's 2013-10-17. No round near $1B. The base also carries this company as cloudius-systems.

Consumer spending analytics from card transactions. Acq. by Bloomberg, 2020; the Business Journals called it San Mateo-based at the sale, while the Y Combinator row reads San Francisco.

Cloud data security posture management, New York with development in Tel Aviv. Graduated: the company's release of 2025-04-22 is headed 'Sentra Closes $50 Million Series B'. The a16z row named Sentra is a 2025 speedrun company, a name collision.

AI agents that build and test mobile game marketing creatives, an Israeli company (Calcalist), Tel Aviv. AI fraud detection and claims automation for insurers, Paris. Multi-carrier shipping API, San Francisco. Entry is the Series A. Headquartered in Ottawa.

Shop management software for auto repair shops; city as the Headline and ICONIQ rows read. The 2021 Series C is the newest round; no $1B mark.

Creator commerce and affiliate platform, New York. The firm's own post: 'Bessemer Venture Partners leads ShopMy's $77.5 million Series B financing' (2025-01-24). Silicon anode battery materials, Alameda.
